name: Pyr-T
summary: Pyr-T, also known as N,N-tetramethylenetryptamine or as 3-(2-pyrrolidinoethyl)indole, is a lesser-known serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine and pyrrolidinylethylindole families. It is the cyclized derivative of diethyltryptamine (DET) in which the N,N-diethyl groups have been fused into a pyrrolidine ring.

pharmacology.text: Pyr-T has been found to show affinity for serotonin receptors, including the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors. Its affinities (IC50) for these receptors were 30 nM for the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor, 110 nM for the 5-HT2A receptor, and 750 nM for the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor.

uses.en: It is a little-known research compound with no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是鮮為人知的研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是鲜为人知的研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Tryptamine psychedelics as a group can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, a faster heart rate and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。色胺類迷幻藥整體而言可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳加快和驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。色胺类迷幻药整体而言可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳加快和惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: In pyr-T, the two methyl groups of DMT are replaced by a five-membered pyrrolidine ring wrapped around the nitrogen. Its six-membered cousin is pip-T.
fact.zh: 在 pyr-T 中，DMT 的兩個甲基被一個環繞氮原子的五元吡咯啶環取代。它的六元環近親是 pip-T。
fact.zhHans: 在 pyr-T 中，DMT 的两个甲基被一个环绕氮原子的五元吡咯啶环取代。它的六元环近亲是 pip-T。
